body: ANSWER WITH BASE EVIDENCE: zero-subject refusal is neither new nor untested. On parent e907d46, PopulationAggregate.of already begins `if subjects.isEmpty then Left(AlignError.SizeMismatch("population has no subjects"))`; the old final branch could only construct after that guard. PopulationSuite already contains `assert(PopulationAggregate.of(view, Vector.empty).isLeft)` in the constructor-check test. My NonEmptyVector field makes that existing public invariant structural instead of relying on an earlier branch; it does not change the outcome. The assignment also explicitly required the receipt over a NonEmptyVector. I agree the distinction matters: zero recall units is a datum within one enrolled subject; zero subjects means there is no population artifact or receipt to certify. I will sharpen the factory Scaladoc to name the pre-existing empty-population failure and make the test assert the exact SizeMismatch payload while amending for the independently found laws seam.
